text:
nora: Quick flag from yesterday's onboarding: Node quickstart users keep hitting 429s when they page through embeddings.
ali: saw the logs. pattern: sample does parallel page fetches and the client retries immediately, so bursts amplify.
pat: can you paste the code?
nora: it's basically `await Promise.all(cursorList.map(c => client.embeddings.page({ cursor: c })))` — naive parallelism.
ali: yeah that will hit tenant burst quotas. Also JS SDK retries have no jitter atm, so retries collide.
pat: SDK parity issue: Python exports `RateLimiter`/`Throttle`, JS currently keeps the limiter internal. makes it hard for sample apps to share token-bucket.
nora: proposal: quick patch to sample -> use `p-limit(3)` as a stopgap and update quickstart docs. longer-term: export `createRateLimiter({permitsPerSec, burst})` from JS SDK.
ali: agree. also auth refresh race: when token refresh happens, multiple inflight requests get 401 then all retry, causing duplicate workload and more 429s. we should singleflight the refresh.
pat: small `auth.onceRefresh()` wrapper should do it: return existing refresh promise if present, otherwise start refresh. I'll PR it.
support: a customer filed a case yesterday after hitting this in prod. they thought quota was wrong. KB request created.
ci-bot: preview build with sample fix available: https://deployments.redwood-inference.dev/pr/589
nora: nice. For retries let's standardize on small exponential backoff + jitter: `delay = Math.min(2000, 100 * 2**attempt) * (0.75 + Math.random()*0.5)`. keeps retries spaced but bounded.
ali: let's also add a `concurrency` option to the paginator helper: `for await (const p of client.embeddings.paginate(q, {concurrency: 2})) {}` so examples don't need to rework developer flow. low friction.
pat: exporting limiter + paginator concurrency + auth singleflight should cut most onboarding 429s. I'll open PRs and link them.
support: adding a short troubleshooting section to quickstart: "If you see 429s while paging: reduce concurrency, use SDK limiter, or add jittered backoff" and include code snippets.
ci-bot: KB draft: https://kb.redwood-inference.dev/quickstart-429s (internal)
nora: can we also add `x-client-concurrency` header to outgoing requests so support can see client-side concurrency in logs? helps triage.
ali: good idea. small header so it doesn't leak sensitive info.
pat: timeline: small changes (p-limit in sample, docs, KB) -> today. SDK exports + paginator concurrency -> ship early next week.
nora: thanks team. this should reduce onboarding tickets and make quickstarts more resilient. :raised_hands:
